description_en: Queries the execution status of a document parsing task
description_zh: 查询文档解析任务的执行状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-doc-parser-job-status --dts-job-id dts-20250729-l3m1213ye7l0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --rag-instance-id example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDocParserJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The task ID (DtsJobId) returned when the document parsing task was created
parameters.help_zh: 创建文档解析任务时返回的任务ID（DtsJobId）
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the task. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code. This parameter will be deprecated
DynamicCode.description_zh: 动态错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s placeholder in the ErrMessage response parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Status.description_en:
The status of the DTS document parsing task. Valid values:

NotStarted: not started.
Running: document parsing in progress.
Suspending: pausing.
Failed: document parsing failed.
Finished: document parsing completed
Status.description_zh:
DTS文档解析任务状态，取值：

NotStarted：未启动。
Running：文档解析中。
Suspending：暂停中。
Failed：文档解析失败。
Finished：文档解析完成

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
